summary: Pixelfed is a federated (ActivityPub) open-source photo-sharing and social-networking platform built on Laravel/PHP. Users upload photos/videos as statuses with media, follow each other, like/comment/reblog/bookmark posts, send direct messages, publish ephemeral stories, join topic groups, follow hashtags, and federate with remote instances over ActivityPub; admins moderate users/instances/content. Persisted business entities span the full social graph (users, profiles, statuses, media, likes, followers, DMs, stories, groups, notifications, reports) plus federation state and admin/moderation records.
